+def parse_content_length_header(value):
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (bool, float)):
+        print(f"Warning: invalid Content-Length header value: {value!r}")
+        return None
+    try:

+        return None
+    if length < 0:

+        return None
+    return length
